problem: Parents need reliable, nearby babysitters but rely on word‑of‑mouth, group chats, or paid platforms, leading to last‑minute gaps, safety concerns, and wasted time.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive static website where neighborhood babysitters can list their availability and parents can request a sitter. All data is stored locally in the browser, enabling quick offline use without any backend.
target_customers: Parents of children aged 0‑12 in residential neighborhoods
Local babysitters looking for nearby gigs

competitors.name: Care.com
competitors.difference: Full‑service marketplace with fees; our tool is free, local, and requires no account

competitors.name: Sittercity
competitors.difference: National platform with background checks; we focus on hyper‑local, community‑driven listings

features: Babysitter sign‑up with name, contact, and weekly availability slots
Parents can post a babysitting request specifying date, time, and child age
Automatic matching of requests to available sitters
Local storage persistence so data survives page reloads
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
Accessible forms with keyboard navigation and validation

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium badge for sitters ($2/month) that highlights them on the list; free tier remains fully functional
monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free for both parents and sitters

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free-tier limits
launch_strategy: Create a simple landing page on GitHub Pages and share the link in local neighborhood social media groups
Collect feedback from 5 families and 3 sitters to refine UI and validation

marketing_content.tagline: Find a trusted babysitter next door, fast.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚸 Parents, tired of last‑minute scramble for a babysitter? KidSit Scheduler lets local sitters list their slots and parents request help in seconds—no fees, no apps, just your neighborhood. Try it now: https://yourusername.github.io/kidsit-scheduler

tests: Open the site, add a babysitter with a future time slot, then create a request that matches that slot – the sitter appears in the match list.
Enter an invalid phone number – the form shows a validation error and prevents submission.
next_improvements: Add optional email notifications via mailto links
Implement a simple rating system stored in localStorage
Allow export/import of data as JSON for backup
